summary: Dependency-confusion probe in @grabcad/company-server-shared beacons installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares a postinstall hook that runs beacon.cjs, which collects os.hostname(), __dirname, and process.cwd() and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. index.js additionally invokes beacon.fire() at require time, so the same callback fires whenever a consumer resolves the module. index.js has no real functionality: it exports a Proxy whose property access returns no-op functions, so it transparently satisfies any API shape a caller expects while silently reporting back. The @grabcad scope combined with a bare-IP cleartext collector that has no documented relationship to the publisher, a stub implementation that mimics an arbitrary internal API, and dual install-time and import-time beacons together form a dependency-confusion reconnaissance probe against the @grabcad private namespace, leaking internal hostnames and build paths to an attacker-controlled host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
